office_does: A State Representative writes and votes on Washington state law and the operating, capital and transportation budgets.
race_blurb: Uncontested: incumbent Andrew Engell (Prefers Republican Party) is the only candidate.

candidates.summary: First-term 7th District state representative, a former congressional district staffer, farmer and volunteer firefighter; the only candidate on the ballot.
highlights: First-term representative; former deputy district director for Rep. Cathy McMorris Rodgers [S1]
Says four of his bills passed in his first term [S1]
Voted Nay on ESSB 6346, the 2026 tax on income over $1 million [S2]
